name: Gordunni Orb
summary: A Gordunni Orb is a powerful magical object taken from the Gordunni in Feralas. Its magic may help reveal the purpose of their dark ceremony.

sections.title: A Mage's Orb
sections.body: Rok Orhan in Camp Mojache seeks a Gordunni Orb to learn more about the Gordunni and their magic. The orb is gathered from one of the Gordunni mage-lords. Its power may help uncover what their dark ceremony is for.

sections.title: In Orgrimmar
sections.body: Rok Orhan sends the Gordunni Orb to Uthel'nay at Darkbriar Lodge in Orgrimmar. Uthel'nay recognizes its great power and warns that it is dangerous.

faq.answer: The Gordunni Orb is a powerful magical object held by Gordunni mage-lords in Feralas.
Rok Orhan in Camp Mojache seeks the orb to learn more about the Gordunni and their magic.

faq.q: What is the orb used for?
faq.answer: Rok Orhan hopes the orb's power will help reveal more about the Gordunni's dark ceremony.
Uthel'nay at Darkbriar Lodge in Orgrimmar can tell more about the orb.
Uthel'nay says the Gordunni Orb is very powerful and dangerous.

angles.text: As a mage, you may recognize why Rok Orhan seeks the orb: its magic could help reveal more about the Gordunni's ceremony.
As a member of the Horde, you can help Rok Orhan of Camp Mojache learn more about the Gordunni and plan their downfall.
